definitions.gloss: rapid advance; remarkable progress; leaping forward
definitions.explanation: Making rapid, impressive progress or advancement. Used for companies, countries, athletes, or any entity that achieves notable growth or success in a short time.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{躍進|やくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げた→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧。
⟦{新興国|しんこうこく}→新興国：21746_shinkoukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{世界経済|せかいけいざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{躍進|やくしん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Emerging nations are making rapid progress in the global economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{躍進|やくしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}った→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: The remarkable progress of young players stood out.

notes:
WRITING:
- {躍|やく} - leap, jump
- {進|しん} - advance, progress

The compound literally captures the image of "leaping forward" in progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {躍進|やくしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to make rapid progress
- {躍進|やくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧ - to achieve rapid advancement
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}ましい→目覚ましい：13628_mezamashii⟧{躍進|やくしん} - remarkable progress
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧{躍進|やくしん} - economic leap forward

USAGE:
{躍進|やくしん} is always positive, implying impressive, noteworthy advancement that exceeds normal expectations.

CONTRASTING TERMS:
- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}→停滞：07427_teitai⟧ - stagnation (opposite)
- ⟦{衰退|すいたい}→衰退：07428_suitai⟧ - decline (opposite)
- ⟦{後退|こうたい}→後退：12556_koutai⟧ - retreat, regression
